Lina Park: quick question before my first day  where do team templates live in Notion and how do I get edit access?

Ethan Cole: welcome Lina! :wave: templates are under Redwood Inference > Team Templates and Onboarding. open the page and owners are listed up top.

Lina Park: i can see the workspace but not the pages. SSO shows me as invited.

Ethan Cole: try clearing cookies or open an incognito window, sometimes SSO cache blocks. if still missing, paste a screenshot and i'll add you.

notion-helper: Ticket DOCS-999 created for Lina Park requesting edit access to "New hire checklist". Owner: Ethan Cole. ETA: same day.

Ethan Cole: i added you as editor on the checklist and the "Weekly goals (template)". duplicate templates before editing. :white_check_mark:

Lina Park: got it, can edit now. thanks! :smile:
